title: Video of smoke rising from the water above the object
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Video of smoke rising from the water above the object, about 2011 onward at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We have video of smoke coming out of the water above the object as if it's fuming or emitting gas.

plain: In 2011 a Swedish treasure hunter, Dennis Asberg, and his team found a strange shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland, which some call the Baltic Sea anomaly. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says they have video of smoke rising out of the water right above the object, as if it were fuming or giving off gas. If true, it would suggest the object on the seafloor is somehow still active.
